structurally_excluded.stream: real-time gauge hydrology (USGS NWIS/Water Services) is not read by this tool
structurally_excluded.reason: Declared explicitly to prevent a plausible misreading: the water pillar's dynamic component is USDM weekly drought, not USGS real-time streamflow. Instantaneous gauge discharge is a poor proxy for siting-horizon supply risk and no NWIS endpoint is called anywhere in the codebase.

structurally_excluded.stream: EIA-930 hourly balancing-authority operations are not read by this tool
structurally_excluded.reason: config.EIA_API_KEY exists as an unused optional hook; no EIA endpoint is called. The grid pillar is annual-average (eGRID) plus forward-looking categorical (NERC). Hourly BA data would enable marginal/time-matched emissions — a documented v2 roadmap item, not a current input. See docs/LIMITATIONS.md.

community_friction.basis: Counts of unverified press headlines matching friction terms. Descriptive only: coverage volume tracks media-market size, not community harm, and this modifies no score.
